nrIncident.summary: Normal service between Edinburgh and North Berwick / Newcastle expected by 08:00
nrIncident.routes:
CrossCountry between Aberdeen / Glasgow Central / Dundee and Plymouth, and also between Edinburgh and Birmingham New Street / Bristol Temple Meads / Plymouth
LNER between Inverness / Aberdeen / Edinburgh and London Kings Cross
Lumo between Edinburgh and London Kings Cross
ScotRail between Edinburgh and North Berwick
TransPennine Express between Edinburgh and Newcastle
nrIncident.message:
During the afternoon of yesterday, Sunday 15 November, damage to the overhead wires in the Drem area caused severe disruption between Edinburgh and North Berwick / Newcastle.
Repairs are ongoing but owing to the extent of the damage, this is expected to close all lines between Edinburgh and North Berwick / Dunbar until at least 06:30.
Some early morning services scheduled to run through the area will be cancelled or revised as a result.
A normal service is expected between Edinburgh and North Berwick / Newcastle from 08:00.
LNER customer advice:
Service alterations:
• 05:37 Edinburgh to London Kings Cross service will be cancelled
• 05:50 Edinburgh to London Kings Cross service will start from Newcastle
• 06:30 London Kings Cross to Edinburgh service will be cancelled
Ticket easements:
If you have a LNER train ticket dated for Sunday 15 November and deferred travel, you will be able to use your ticket at no extra cost on another LNER service today, Monday 16, or tomorrow, Tuesday 17 November. It is recommended that you make a new seat reservation which can be done on LNER's website.
Reimbursement of hotel and transport costs:
If you were unable to complete your journey yesterday, LNER advised to arrange accommodation or arrange your own transport. Costs of these can be reimbursed by emailing customers@lner.co.uk with a copy of your receipts.
Lumo customer advice:
Service alterations:
• 06:26 Edinburgh to London Kings Cross service will start from Newcastle
Ticket easements:
If you have a Lumo train ticket dated for Sunday 15 November and deferred travel, you will be able to use your ticket at no extra cost on another Lumo service today, Monday 16 November.
ScotRail customer advice:
The first service expected to run from Edinburgh to North Berwick will be at 07:15.
The first service expected to run from North Berwick to Edinburgh will be at 07:53.
TransPennine Express customer advice:
Service alterations:
• 05:43 Edinburgh to Newcastle service will be cancelled
Ticket easements:
If you have a TransPennine Express train ticket dated for Sunday 15 November and deferred travel between Edinburgh and Newcastle, you will be able to use your ticket at no extra cost on another TransPennine Express service today, Monday 16 November.
Ticket flexibility:
If your train is cancelled, you will be able to travel on an alternative service operated by any other participating train company, either two hours before or two hours after the original departure time of the cancelled service, in order to reach your destination.
If you decide not to travel or cannot complete your journey due to cancellations, you are entitled to a full refund from your original point of sale.
For further information and guidance please contact your train company or speak to a member of railway staff.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
